issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: akta.pro
products.tagline: Private company data and signals API for the agent economy
products.summaryZh: 面向代理经济的私有企业数据与信号API
products.descriptionZh: 私有公司数据，深度为PitchBook的4倍，覆盖范围为2倍，另含100多种事件信号及跨公司、行业和主题的新闻。可用于寻找和尽职调查交易，或制作外联名单并触发外呼。专为金融服务和GTM团队设计，按需付费。
products.description: Private company data with 4x the depth and 2x the coverage of PitchBook, plus 100+ event signals and news across companies, industries, and topics. Source and diligence deals or make outreach lists and trigger outbound. Built for financial services and GTM teams, pay-as-you-go.

products.name: Diet Claude
products.tagline: Never get blindsided by Claude's usage limits again
products.summaryZh: 再也不会被Claude的使用限制打个措手不及。
products.descriptionZh: 工作中突然碰到Claude的限制真是烦人。Diet Claude提供实时用量表，显示你已使用的会话量、剩余时间以及限制重置时间。它通过上下文修剪、精简提示词、推荐合适模型来优化令牌使用。即使真的用完了，它也会将对话和上下文转移到另一个LLM，而不是从头开始。
products.description: Hitting Claude's limit mid-work is annoying af. Diet Claude gives a live usage meter shows how much of your session you’ve used, how much time is left, and when your limits reset. It helps optimise token usage by context trimming, tightening prompts, suggesting apt models. And when you do run dry, it carries your conversation and context over to another LLM instead of starting from scratch.

products.name: Agnost AI
products.tagline: Catch agent failures your evals miss
products.summaryZh: 捕捉评估遗漏的代理故障
products.descriptionZh: Agnost AI分析用户与你的生产环境AI代理之间的对话，并发现：静默失败、代理行为漂移、幻觉、用户挫败感、隐藏的功能请求以及流失信号。它将这些问题归类为重复出现的模式，展示每个洞察背后的具体用户和对话，并将其转化为评估和修复措施。
products.description: Agnost AI analyzes conversations between users and your production AI agents and discovers: silent failures, agent behavior drift, hallucinations, user frustration, hidden feature requests, and churn signals. It groups them into recurring patterns, shows the exact users and conversations behind each insight, and turns them into evals and fixes.

products.name: Jotform AI Data Assistant
products.tagline: Turn form data into insights and action with AI
products.summaryZh: 利用AI将表单数据转化为洞察与行动。
products.descriptionZh: Jotform Data Assistant将您收集的数据转化为答案、洞察和行动。只需让它创建或整理表格、分析提交内容、发现趋势、生成图表、总结回复或批量更新记录。它直接内置于Jotform Tables和Inbox中，通过自然对话帮助您管理整个提交后工作流程，无需公式、复杂筛选或重复性手动操作。
products.description: Jotform Data Assistant turns the data you collect into answers, insights, and action. Simply ask it to create or organize tables, analyze submissions, uncover trends, generate charts, summarize responses, or update records in bulk. Built directly into Jotform Tables and Inbox, it helps you manage your entire post-submission workflow through natural conversation, no formulas, complex filters, or repetitive manual work required.

products.name: Nimbia
products.tagline: AI screen-sharing calls for user onboarding
products.summaryZh: AI屏幕共享用于用户引导
products.descriptionZh: Nimbia是一款通过屏幕共享通话来引导和培训软件产品新用户的人工智能。它能说话、能倾听，还能实际点击用户的屏幕，因此能提供真正的帮助。首家使用Nimbia的公司因此实现了40%的更快增长。在与之前的引导方案进行A/B测试对比时，Nimbia使首周激活率和试用转付费转化率提升了1.4倍。
products.description: Nimbia is an AI that does screen-sharing calls to onboard and train new users of software products. It speaks, listens, and can actually click on the user's screen, so it can be truly helpful. The very first company using Nimbia is growing 40% faster because of it. When they ran an A/B test against their previous onboarding solution, Nimbia delivered 1.4X higher week-one activation and trial-to-paid conversion rates.

products.name: Memoria
products.tagline: Search photos by text, speech, object & faces. 100% offline.
products.summaryZh: 通过文字、语音、物体和人脸搜索照片。100%离线。
products.descriptionZh: 厌倦了无尽地滑动屏幕？Memoria是一款针对你相册的本地搜索引擎。它利用设备端AI转录视频音频、读取截图中的文字，并识别面孔和物体。无需云端，无需订阅。输入所说或所写的内容，它就能找到对应的媒体。
products.description: Tired of endless scrolling? Memoria is a local search engine for your camera roll. It uses on-device AI to transcribe video audio, read text in screenshots, and recognize faces and objects. No cloud, no subscriptions. Type what was said or written, it finds the media.

products.name: coolplugz
products.tagline: A Claude orchestrator that saves developers loads of time
products.summaryZh: 一个Claude编排器，为开发者节省大量时间
products.descriptionZh: 一个编排层，引导Claude Code完成编码任务，无需您持续监督。它从Jira、Github、Notion和Slack获取您的上下文，编写提示词，并验证Claude Code是否正确完成任务。
products.description: An orchestration layer that guides Claude Code to deliver your coding tasks without requiring your constant supervision. It fetches your context from Jira, Github, Notion and Slack, writes your prompts and verifies that claude code completes tasks correctly.

products.name: Purchase API by Agentcard
products.tagline: one API call and your agent buys anything online
products.summaryZh: 一次API调用，你的智能体即可在线购买任何商品。
products.descriptionZh: 您的代理现在可以通过一次API调用完成购买。告诉它从Y处购买X，Agentcard会找到产品、执行结账，并使用一次性卡片完成支付。目前支持DoorDash、Amazon以及大多数Shopify和Stripe商店。从agentcard.sh试用，您的首单免费！
products.description: your agent can now buy things with one API call. tell it buy X from Y and Agentcard finds the product, runs checkout and pays with a single use card. works today with DoorDash, Amazon and most Shopify and Stripe stores. try it from agentcard.sh, your first order is free!

products.name: Ninjō AI
products.tagline: AI sales agents on any channel that runs from Claude Code
products.summaryZh: 在任何渠道上运行的AI销售代理，基于Claude Code构建。
products.descriptionZh: Ninjō是面向Instagram、WhatsApp及所有销售渠道的AI销售代理基础设施。通过MCP与Claude、ChatGPT、Claude Code或Codex对话，即可创建、测试、分析并改进代理——基于150多个生产环境代理验证的模板，这些代理已为客户带来实际收入（累计75万美元）。支持版本化变更与即时回滚、合成对话测试、跟进、关键词触发及内置CRM。数分钟内即可从零上线。免费起步，含1,000条消息。
products.description: Ninjō is infrastructure for AI sales agents on Instagram, WhatsApp & every channel where you sell. Create, test, analyze and improve agents by talking to Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code or Codex via MCP — backed by templates validated across 150+ production agents that closed real revenue ($750K generated for clients). Versioned changes with instant rollback, synthetic-conversation testing, follow-ups, keyword triggers and a built-in CRM. Zero to live in minutes. Start free with 1,000 messages.

products.name: Flare
products.tagline: The graph-first IDE and interactive map for agentic coding
products.summaryZh: 面向智能体编程的图优先IDE与交互式地图
products.descriptionZh: 大多数智能编码工具给你的是一份聊天记录。Flare给你的是一张地图。每个文件是一个节点，每次导入是一条边，底层是一个真实的终端，你可以在其中运行claude、codex或opencode。图谱随智能体编辑实时更新，将每次写入归因于操作者，并在它重写应用其他部分所导入的内容时提醒你。变更突发快照保存到本地历史，你可以对比和回滚。智能体通过MCP从看板领取任务。运行在你的机器上。无需账户。MIT许可。
products.description: Most agentic coding tools hand you a chat log. Flare hands you the map. Every file is a node, every import an edge, with a real terminal underneath where you run claude, codex or opencode. The graph updates live as the agent edits, attributes every write to whoever made it, and pulls you in when it rewrites something the rest of the app imports. Change bursts snapshot to local history you can diff and revert. Agents take work from a board over MCP. Your machine. No account. MIT licensed.

products.name: DockDuck
products.tagline: The native macOS file manager Finder should be
products.summaryZh: macOS 自带的文件管理器 Finder 应当
products.descriptionZh: DockDuck 是 macOS 原生文件管理器，Finder 本该如此——快速、美观，且 100% 使用 Swift 编写。支持标签页、双窗格、固定起始仪表盘、标签、即时搜索、批量重命名，以及连接服务器（SFTP/SMB）——所有这些都集成在一个点击即开的窗口中。一次付费，无需订阅。你的文件永远不会离开 Mac。
products.description: DockDuck is the native macOS file manager Finder should be — fast, beautiful, and 100% Swift. Tabs, dual-pane, a pinned Start dashboard, tags, instant search, batch rename, and connect to servers(SFTP/SMB) — all in one window that opens the moment you click. Pay once, no subscription. Your files never leave your Mac.

products.name: Particle Studio
products.tagline: Transform Static Images Into Dynamic Particle Experiences
products.summaryZh: 将静态图像转化为动态粒子体验
products.descriptionZh: Particle Studio 可将您的图片转化为可交互、可自定义的粒子组合。上传图片，从圆形、方形、三角形或立方体中选择，并微调粒子大小、运动轨迹和光标交互，打造专属视觉体验。满意结果后，可通过“复制链接”即时分享，或使用“导出 HTML 包”将其带出工作室，生成离线交互版本，供您使用自己的图片进行实验。
products.description: Particle Studio turns your images into interactive, customizable particle compositions. Upload an image, choose from circles, squares, triangles, or cubes, and fine-tune particle size, motion trails, and cursor interaction to create your own visual experience. When you're happy with the result, share it instantly with Copy Link or take it beyond the studio with Export HTML Bundle to create an offline, interactive version you can experiment with using your own images.

products.name: Marble MCP
products.tagline: Manage your CMS content from Claude, Cursor, and Codex
products.summaryZh: 在Claude、Cursor和Codex中管理您的CMS内容
products.descriptionZh: Marble现已内置MCP服务器，让你可以直接从Claude、Cursor和Codex等AI编程工具管理CMS内容。无需离开编辑器或终端，即可创建文章、更新内容和管理媒体。
products.description: Marble now ships an MCP server, letting you manage your CMS content directly from AI coding tools like Claude, Cursor, and Codex. Create posts, update content, and manage media without leaving your editor or terminal.

products.name: Keymap
products.tagline: Every shortcut, one ⌘⌘ away.
products.summaryZh: 每个快捷键，只需⌘⌘即可触达。
products.descriptionZh: Keymap 是一款 macOS 菜单栏应用，能显示你正在使用的应用中的所有菜单快捷键。双击 ⌘ 键即可唤出面板。本地运行，保护隐私。
products.description: Keymap is a macOS menubar app that shows every menu shortcut in the app you're using. Double-press ⌘ to summon the panel. Local and private.

products.name: Postaway.space
products.tagline: A little piece of the past, sent your way.
products.summaryZh: 一小段过往，寄予你手。
products.descriptionZh: Postaway将复古明信片的魅力带入数字世界。选择一个目的地，写下留言，我们会随机搭配一张复古明信片，供你通过链接分享。使用完全免费。喜欢明信片？加入Postaway邮件俱乐部，即可收到一张真实的复古明信片，还有更多惊喜。你永远不知道会收到什么。
products.description: Postaway brings the charm of vintage postcards to the digital world. Pick a destination, write a message, and we’ll randomly pair it with a vintage postcard you can share by link. It’s free to use. Love postcards? Join the Postaway Mail Club for a real vintage postcard in the mail, plus other surprises. You never know what you’ll get.

products.name: Hacktron Automations
products.tagline: Close the loop between vulnerability discovery and patching.
products.summaryZh: 在漏洞发现与修复之间形成闭环。
products.descriptionZh: Hacktron 已能审查你的代码、检测真实漏洞，并从你的反馈中学习。现在，它还能修复这些漏洞。通过自动化功能，Hacktron 像真正的工程师一样，验证安全问题、消除误报，并实施补丁。只需设置一次规则，Hacktron 便会在每次触发时执行操作。首个操作是修复——Hacktron 动态验证发现，并为你的团队提供经过充分测试、可随时审查的修复方案。
products.description: Hacktron already reviews your code, detects real vulnerabilities, and learns from your feedback. Now it fixes the vulnerabilities too. With automations, Hacktron acts like a real engineer, validating security issues, eliminating false positives, and implementing patches. Set the rules once, and Hacktron performs an action on every trigger. The first action is remediation - Hacktron validates the finding dynamically, and hands your team a well-tested, ready-to-review fix.

products.name: session-indexer
products.tagline: Semantic search over your own Claude Code session history
products.summaryZh: 搜索你自己的Claude Code会话历史。
products.descriptionZh: 按项目对Claude Code会话历史进行语义搜索——并非共享或集中式记忆存储。将JSONL转录索引到本地SQLite文件，通过bge-m3嵌入（Ollama）检索，并自动回退至FTS5 BM25，在会话开始时自动注入相关过往上下文。作为session-end的补充：session-end提供“我停在哪里”，session-indexer提供“我们决定了什么”——使用相同的Stop/SessionStart钩子。Apache 2.0许可，75项通过测试，go install即可，无需部署。
products.description: Per-project semantic search over your Claude Code session history — not a shared or centralized memory store. Indexes JSONL transcripts into a local SQLite file, retrieves via bge-m3 embeddings (Ollama) with automatic FTS5 BM25 fallback, and auto-injects relevant past context at session start. Companion to session-end: session-end gives "where I left off," session-indexer gives "what we decided" — same Stop/SessionStart hooks. Apache 2.0, 75 passing tests, go install and nothing to deploy.

products.name: Buddy Visual Tests
products.tagline: Every UI change, reviewed before merge
products.summaryZh: 每次UI变更，合并前均需审查。
products.descriptionZh: AI代理不仅能构建你的用户界面，现在还能测试其实际外观。Buddy Visual Tests捕获每一次UI变更，逐像素与已批准的基线进行对比，并将视觉回归测试直接融入你的交付流程。借助CLI、MCP和Skills支持，代理能发现视觉缺陷、修复它们、重新运行测试，并将有意变更提交给人工审批。
products.description: Not only can AI agents build your UI, they can now test what it actually looks like. Buddy Visual Tests captures every UI change, compares it pixel by pixel with an approved baseline, and brings visual regression testing straight into your delivery flow. With CLI, MCP and Skills support, agents can spot visual bugs, fix them, rerun tests, and hand over intentional changes for human approval.

products.name: Altar II
products.tagline: The mechanical keyboard Apple never made
products.summaryZh: 苹果从未做过的机械键盘
products.descriptionZh: 纤薄惊人，全机械结构。Altar II将卓越的打字体验与令人难以置信的设计融为一体。
products.description: Shockingly thin, fully mechanical. Altar II combines a superlative typing experience with an unbelievable design.

products.name: ChatGPT Ad Library
products.tagline: See every ad running inside ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 查看ChatGPT内运行的所有广告。
products.descriptionZh: ChatGPT内首个公开赞助广告库：11,103位广告主，415,289个广告位，以及970个细分领域中的43,410个独立创意，每个创意均关联至触发它的确切提示词。监控竞争对手广告，优化您的点击率。
products.description: The first public library of sponsored ads running inside ChatGPT: 11,103 advertisers, 415,289 ad placements, and 43,410 unique creatives across 970 niches each linked to the exact prompt that triggered it. Spy on Competitors ads and optimise your CTR.
